name: TOTP Administrative Reset Handler
summary: Enforces operator authorization, fresh MFA and target-organization membership before delegating target-user TOTP cleanup to the real MFA manager and recording actor/target audit evidence.

sourceReferences.note: Requires system-admin or active-org-admin authority, recent LastMfaDateTimeUtc, target membership in the active organization, and dedicated actor/target reset audit evidence.
Target factor cleanup is delegated to the real ResetMfaAsync primitive, which removes secure authenticator and recovery-code material.
